questions.title: Current usage
intent_phrases: How much usage is in this session/today/this week/the selected window? Variants include token breakdown and current project
prohibited_claims: infer completion, productivity, or remaining allowance
questions.lower_model_hint: Report the four token classes and stated total formula; keep missing values null and do not infer outcomes.

questions.title: Top sessions and concentration
intent_phrases: List my top threads/sessions by usage and How concentrated is usage?
prohibited_claims: call a large session wasteful or semantically group sessions by label
questions.lower_model_hint: Use returned labels and selectors, state concentration arithmetically, and never translate size into quality.

questions.title: Period change and drivers
intent_phrases: Compare the last seven days to the previous seven and explain which sessions/projects/models/tools account for the arithmetic change
prohibited_claims: turn arithmetic contribution into causal explanation
questions.lower_model_hint: Describe signed arithmetic drivers that reconcile to the delta; label them non-causal.

questions.title: Model, effort, and service-tier mix
intent_phrases: Which model/effort combinations consume each token class?
prohibited_claims: claim one profile is better without comparable outcomes
questions.lower_model_hint: Keep unknown model attributes explicit and compare usage mix only, not model quality.

questions.title: Project and session-family usage
intent_phrases: Which projects or parent/subagent families dominate?
prohibited_claims: infer semantic task families from labels
questions.lower_model_hint: Keep project-exclusive and family-inclusive modes separate and do not invent semantic grouping.

questions.title: Most expensive entities
intent_phrases: Which calls, turns, or sessions have the highest current estimated dollar or credit value?
prohibited_claims: label estimate as billed cost or reconstruct historical prices
questions.lower_model_hint: Call values configured estimates, disclose rated and unrated coverage, and retain unpriced rows.

questions.title: Pricing and credit gaps
intent_phrases: How much usage lacks cost or credit estimates, and which models explain the gap?
prohibited_claims: report total spend as complete below 100% coverage
questions.lower_model_hint: Lead with valuation coverage and reasons; never present partial estimated spend as complete.

questions.title: Poor cache reuse under high input
intent_phrases: Where is cache reuse low despite high input?
prohibited_claims: equate poor cache reuse with workflow quality
questions.lower_model_hint: Return candidates with the observed threshold and cache formula; do not grade workflow quality.

questions.title: Context-pressure trajectory
intent_phrases: Which sessions approach context limits or deteriorate across turns?
prohibited_claims: prescribe splitting or claim causality
questions.lower_model_hint: Keep epochs separate, disclose context-window coverage, and describe trajectory without prescribing a split.

questions.title: Token acceleration
intent_phrases: Which sessions accelerate across successive turns?
prohibited_claims: call acceleration waste or caused by context
questions.lower_model_hint: Repeat the versioned statistic and sample rule; acceleration is a feature, not a waste judgment.

questions.title: Largest uncached-input jumps
intent_phrases: Where did new input jump most between consecutive calls/turns?
prohibited_claims: attribute jump to the preceding event
questions.lower_model_hint: Show both boundary calls and the delta inside one epoch; state that temporal adjacency is non-causal.

questions.title: Tool-output adjacency
intent_phrases: Which large tool outputs were followed by the largest new-input increase?
prohibited_claims: say tool output was included or caused the increase
questions.lower_model_hint: Use adjacent sequence facts only, include intervening events, and explicitly reject causal attribution.

questions.title: Cached replay with small output
intent_phrases: Where is large cached replay producing little model output?
prohibited_claims: infer little useful work because tools may carry the action
questions.lower_model_hint: Report the observed pair and ratio; do not treat small model output as low task value.

questions.title: Context composition
intent_phrases: How much observed context belongs to tools, MCP, files, messages, or other structural categories?
prohibited_claims: expose raw bodies or claim observed source content was included in a call
questions.lower_model_hint: Run only when structural-context capability exists; return categories and basis without raw content.

questions.title: Compaction effect
intent_phrases: How did token/context behavior differ immediately before and after compaction?
prohibited_claims: claim compaction caused improvement or degradation
questions.lower_model_hint: Compare symmetric disclosed windows around the boundary and keep any causal interpretation model-owned.

questions.title: Growth without observed state change
intent_phrases: Which sessions combine context growth with few observed mutations?
prohibited_claims: say no useful work occurred or a tool failed to change state
questions.lower_model_hint: Treat returned values as investigation features; few observed mutations do not prove little useful work.

questions.title: Long versus split sessions
intent_phrases: Do long sessions differ from newly split related sessions?
prohibited_claims: recommend splitting from label similarity or length alone
questions.lower_model_hint: This question is deferred unless the user supplies explicit cohorts; never infer related work from labels.

questions.title: Turn count and completion efficiency
intent_phrases: How many turns/calls/tokens did sessions use before observed completion?
prohibited_claims: treat fewer turns as better or end-of-file as completion
questions.lower_model_hint: Separate completed, open, failed, and cancelled cohorts and repeat the observed completion basis.

questions.title: Before first action and mutation
intent_phrases: How much time/tokens occurred before first tool action, successful tool, and observed mutation?
prohibited_claims: attribute later mutation to only the boundary call/tool
questions.lower_model_hint: Report action, successful completion, and observed mutation as three separate boundaries; do not assign causality.

questions.title: Repeated resource operations
intent_phrases: Which files/resources were repeatedly read, searched, written, tested, or revisited?
prohibited_claims: call repetition unnecessary
questions.lower_model_hint: Describe exact repeated operations and revisit distance; leave whether repetition was necessary to the user/model.

questions.title: Inspect-fail-reinspect-retry cycles
intent_phrases: Show repeated inspect, attempt, failure, reinspect, retry sequences
prohibited_claims: label cycle waste or failure cause
questions.lower_model_hint: Show the exact matched sequence and status; do not infer waste or why a failure occurred.

questions.title: Tool family behavior
intent_phrases: Which tools/operations dominate calls, latency, output, failures, and adjacent token activity?
prohibited_claims: convert unknown to zero or name tool ID before human tool name
questions.lower_model_hint: Lead with human tool name and semantic operation; keep missing duration/output null and adjacency non-causal.

questions.title: Tool output versus following model activity
intent_phrases: Compare tool output size with the next model-call token mix
prohibited_claims: claim output caused or was included in context
questions.lower_model_hint: Present tool output and following token classes as adjacent observations, not inclusion or causality.

questions.title: Resource hotspots
intent_phrases: Which resources receive the most reads, writes, tests, time, output, or observed changes?
prohibited_claims: call a hot resource a bottleneck without supporting timing
questions.lower_model_hint: Separate operations, durations, output, and observed mutations; use bottleneck language only with timing evidence.

questions.title: Model and effort transitions
intent_phrases: Where did model, effort, or service tier change within a session?
prohibited_claims: infer why the host/model changed or which choice was better
questions.lower_model_hint: Report exact consecutive profile changes and token deltas without explaining motivation or quality.

questions.title: Automation or skill candidates
intent_phrases: Which repeated structural workflows might deserve a script, skill, or optimized endpoint?
prohibited_claims: persist `skill_candidate` or promise savings
questions.lower_model_hint: Use the returned structural features to propose investigations only; do not persist candidacy or promise savings.

questions.title: Tool durations and gaps
intent_phrases: Where did long completed-tool durations or observed inactive event gaps occur?
prohibited_claims: call a gap thinking time, hang, user delay, or waste
questions.lower_model_hint: Keep completed-tool duration and adjacent event gap in separate fields and avoid interpreting gaps.

questions.title: Parent and subagent usage
intent_phrases: Which parents delegated most, and how much usage is exclusive to parents, descendants, or the whole family?
prohibited_claims: claim delegation benefit or necessity
questions.lower_model_hint: State parent-exclusive, descendant-exclusive, and family-inclusive scopes separately; do not claim benefit.

questions.title: Delegation behavior comparison
intent_phrases: How do parent and subagent cohorts differ observationally?
prohibited_claims: claim counterfactual savings, quality improvement, or task equivalence
questions.lower_model_hint: Describe observational cohort differences and confounders only; never claim counterfactual savings.

questions.title: Allowance movement and local usage
intent_phrases: Show exact allowance observations/reset boundaries beside local calls, turns, four tokens, cost, and credits
prohibited_claims: claim local events fully explain drain or one call caused a percentage change
questions.lower_model_hint: Report exact observations and compatible local facts together; never claim the local events explain provider drain.

questions.title: Events between observations
intent_phrases: Which exact calls, turns, tools, or mutations occurred between these adjacent observations?
prohibited_claims: assign equal or causal contribution
questions.lower_model_hint: List the exact half-open interval and ordered events; do not assign contribution or causality.

questions.title: Local efficiency per percentage point
intent_phrases: Estimate observed tokens/calls/turns/cost/credits per allowance percentage point
prohibited_claims: call the ratio the provider conversion formula
questions.lower_model_hint: Call each ratio a local observation over compatible positive intervals, not a provider conversion formula.

questions.title: Completed cycle comparison
intent_phrases: Compare local usage and observed allowance movement across completed reset windows
prohibited_claims: infer provider-accounting changes
questions.lower_model_hint: Compare only completed compatible cycles and disclose plan, duration, valuation, and observation coverage.

questions.title: Latest publication changes
intent_phrases: What changed in the latest incremental refresh/publication?
prohibited_claims: label recanonicalization or updated rows as new activity
questions.lower_model_hint: Separate inserted, terminalized, corrected, removed, and recanonicalized changes; do not relabel updates as activity.

questions.title: Data health and freshness
intent_phrases: Is the index fresh/complete enough, and what capabilities or measurements are missing?
prohibited_claims: claim deferred/uncertain sources do not exist
questions.lower_model_hint: Distinguish indexed, guaranteed-complete, deferred, uncertain, and missing coverage without claiming absence.

questions.title: Deduplication/source audit
intent_phrases: Are copied, archived, replaced, or truncated sources changing totals?
prohibited_claims: call physical copies duplicate user work
questions.lower_model_hint: Reconcile semantic entities and physical occurrences; never call copied manifestations duplicate work.

questions.title: Evidence timeline
intent_phrases: Show the exact timeline for this session/turn/call/tool/resource or allowance interval
prohibited_claims: expose raw content, infer causality, or omit blanks by replacing them with zero
questions.lower_model_hint: Preserve exact order, lifecycle basis, token classes, and nulls; never expose bodies or infer causality.

questions.title: Weekly review
intent_phrases: Give me a compact weekly usage review with concentration, change drivers, model/tool/context/allowance facts, coverage, and evidence routes
prohibited_claims: claim productivity, causal waste, or server-authored findings
questions.lower_model_hint: Synthesize only from graded sections, repeat limitations, and route to selectors without claiming productivity or causal waste.

questions.title: Actionable investigations
intent_phrases: Choose up to three evidence-backed investigations
prohibited_claims: claim proven waste, guaranteed savings, or causal diagnosis
questions.lower_model_hint: Rank no more than three investigations from exact feature vectors, citing baselines, limitations, and evidence routes.

questions.title: Compare two sessions
intent_phrases: Compare two sessions structurally by turns, calls, four tokens, tools, resources, changes, context, delegation, and completion
prohibited_claims: assert semantic task equivalence or which session/model is better
questions.lower_model_hint: Compare exact structural facts and deterministic deltas only; disclose scope and coverage and avoid quality judgments.
